name: Incline Push-Up
summary: An easier push-up with the hands raised, ideal for learning the push-up pattern and building up to floor push-ups.
setup: Place your hands on a sturdy bench, sofa arm, table or kitchen counter slightly wider than shoulder width.
Step your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Make sure the surface cannot slide, and brace abs and glutes.
execution: Lower your chest toward the edge of the surface with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body straight and neck neutral.
Press away to straighten your arms.
Use a lower surface to make it harder as you improve.
mistakes: Hips sagging: squeeze glutes and brace the abs.
Elbows flaring wide: tuck them to about 45 degrees.
Using an unstable surface: pick a sturdy, non-slip one.
Short range: lower until the chest nearly touches the surface.
